rows.text:
A Fool known as "Enroute," who wields magic to create Elation.
He conjured gold for the poor to bring them prosperity, and weapons for the oppressed to topple tyranny. All for the sake of making his audience laugh.
Yet desire knows no bounds, and the cost of this laughter grew ever steeper, until he could no longer satisfy the growing thirst.
And so, the masses condemned him as a fraud and put out a bounty on his head, yet the very bounty and weapons used to hunt him down were gifts from this charlatan.
In the end, the Fool declared that Elation was dead, and boarded the Astral Express in search of a way to save it.
